title: Export card and export menu
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-27 exports a real fixture and Office opens the result, in all four theme/control combinations
notes: Shell half of the export pair per ADR 0012; opens only after the T-0239 library is verified and its claim is released. Serves acceptance item A-27 (Export PDF plus the Export card with a format dropdown and Export button: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, image, text, HTML, RTF) from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md. Adds the Export card with the format dropdown, progress and cancel, and an export pill in the command bar, calling the T-0239 writer API and not changing its semantics. Only formats the library actually implements are offered: an unimplemented format is absent, not a disabled ghost control. The export feature-matrix rows become `verified` only when this task lands; until then they stay `library` after T-0239. The app lane runs one task at a time, so earlier app tasks are implicit ordering constraints, not formal dependencies.
